prompts.prompt: In an Axum handler function signature, where must a body-consuming extractor like Json of T be positioned relative to extractors such as State or Path? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/rust-web/SKILL.md - Extractors resolve left-to-right. Body-consuming extractors (Json<T>, Bytes) must be last.

prompts.prompt: For a Rust web service, which crate should define your structured application error enum in the domain layer, and which crate serves as the catch all for internal plumbing where you just need error propagation with context? Answer concisely with both crate names.
prompts.source: plugins/backend/skills/rust-web/SKILL.md - Error Crate Roles: thiserror for structured error enums in libraries/domain layers, anyhow for catch-all application code plumbing
